title: Marie M Possible NDE 7136
content: Prior to my Near Death Experience, I was lying down in bed and feeling the symptoms of a virus in my achy muscles. Then I was really noticing the fever throughout my body. I did not have any access to any aspirin, and honestly, wasn't too concerned about that, as I was trusting God, in all of this. I remember my body had gotten so hot from the fever, that I could no longer lay my leg on top of the other, and had to sprawl them out from one another. Even though my body was feeling miserable, the whole time I had a peace and joy that filled me up inside. A friend who was in the dorm at the time came into my room and asked me what I was doing lying down since it was so nice outside. I said, 'Come here, I want you to feel my head.' She came over and felt it saying, 'Marie, you are burning up, why aren't you in infirmary?' I said to her that I had to wait until tomorrow when they opened. Later on that night, I remember myself in a dark place that was very peaceful. In that place, I felt so alive with so much clarity that I had never felt before. I remember I had many questions come to me and my spirit and I remember asking these questions without even moving my mouth. These questions were deep, deep questions about life that only, it seemed, my spirit was able to ask, and not my cardinal mind. I had no sense of time or space. I remember these questions springing up inside of me, and the answers coming back that I understood completely in a way like I never had before. I can't describe in words the intensity, the depth, of how I understood the answers coming back to me. Then as fast as they came, they were gone. It even got to the point to where before I was done asking my question it would already be answered completely. Since there was no sense of time, it seemed as though the whole night I was asking questions and getting answers. Then a remarkable thing happened that made me realize I was not in my body. I felt myself coming back into my body. My body felt like my spirit was putting a heavy suit on. Actually, I wasn't too thrilled about the whole thing of going back into my body, because not only did my body feel very heavy, but I started feeling all the aches of the virus and the fever. In the morning, I felt like God gave me a parable of what had happened. First, he told me that what I was experiencing with Him was Communion. I had never viewed communion like this. Communion to me, when I was growing up in a Catholic Church, was sitting before the Priest and confessing your sins. The next thing he said was that what I was experiencing was three trails of communion. The first trail was the highest and most powerful: that was the path of spirit, where all is understood in communion between God and man. The next trail was that of the soul. He said that it's not as powerful, because of the soul with its beliefs from growing up, what parents were taught, and its experiences and hurts, that the soul is hindered and therefore filters a lot out in communing and being sensitive to His Presence. The third path is that of the body. That is the part of us who feel His presence upon, around and within ourselves. When I did go to infirmary, I registered a 104 degree temperature, and was assigned to the infirmary for the next week and a half, with what they said was a foreign virus.
